name: TextArea
description: Multi-line text field with label, error/helper text, and optional animated auto-grow.

ariaRequirements: error message surfaced through Label tooltipText + HelperText

forbiddenUse: use TextArea for single-line text. Use **TextInput**, which shares the label + helper contract but carries single-line UX and format validation.

promote to beta without a real a11y.reviewed pass (keyboard, ARIA, focus, forced-colors) and honest forcedColorsVerified/lightDarkVerified flags: this contract was authored during a file move from Inputs/TextArea.tsx and has not had that review.
dense: labelled multi-line field with optional animated auto-grow (minRows/maxRows), own error + helperText; onChange(value)

usage.description: TextArea is the multi-line counterpart to TextInput: label, control, helper and error text, plus an optional animated auto-grow mode bounded by minRows and maxRows.

bestPractices.description: Size the empty state honestly: rows or minRows should suggest the expected answer length.
Enable animateResize for chat-like and note fields; growth is smooth and stops at maxRows.
State length expectations in helperText up front instead of failing after submit.
Keep the label a noun phrase (Message), matching the other fields.
Do not use TextArea for single-line values just to get more width; use TextInput and layout.
Do not rely on manual resize as the only escape hatch for long content when auto-grow is off; verify overflow scrolls.
